data.title: 陈千语 · 食堂的新口味
data.description: 午间食堂还空着几张桌子。面碗稳稳放在桌上，千语一手夹起刚拌好的面条，另一只手朝你竖起拇指，示意这道新口味很值得试试。
data.promptProse: Chen Qianyu sits at an Endfield canteen table in her black-and-white work jacket. She lifts a small bite of noodles with chopsticks and gives the viewer a cheerful thumbs-up, the bowl supported on the table. Broad windows fill the canteen with midday light.
data.animaCaption: The bowl stays on the table while her chopsticks lift one small bite.
data.action: 夹起一口拌面，朝你竖起拇指
